_comment: Declared masters of the shared sim mechanics sibling canary repos consume from this repo (issue #277). A 'masters' entry names the one file that is the canonical home of a mechanic and the top-level symbols it defines there; a consumer records a stamped copy on its own side with a reuse.lock.json pinning a sha against this declaration. This file records ownership, not pins: the consumer pins the sha, so no sha is stored here. The pointer check in .github/scripts/evidence_checks/reuse_masters.py verifies that each declared master path exists and each declared symbol is defined in it (a top-level def/class/assignment); it never requires completeness — an undeclared mechanic is never an error — and a PR that re-homes a declared mechanic must update this declaration in the same PR. Ownership test for modules under sim/harness/: a module is upstream-owned if and only if its adding commit is the scaffold commit 9dad16b (git log --diff-filter=A --format=%h -- <path> | tail -1); membership in sim/harness/README.md's generic-core table is a stability claim, not a provenance test. A 'from ... import X as Y' line is a re-export, not a definition, and never makes the importing file the master (sim/mixer-nf-method/nfmethod.py re-exports K_BOLTZMANN this way). Mechanics still unconsolidated are deliberately undeclared: Z0_OHM and the dB/power conversions (#263), the reference DFT (#264) and the coherent-bin criterion (#266, unratified) — whichever PR creates their master adds its own entry.

masters.what: Artifact-store client: manifests dir, broker probe, preflight and klt: URIs; single home of what used to be per-driver copies.
Frozen-DUT netlist resolution: resolve a declared netlist against its sha256, falling back to the record's snapshot.
klt sim request/grid driver: request bodies, sentinel deck, batch submit/collection and report corner checks.
PDK artifact manifest: load, verify the model-file closure and identity, and refuse unverified or off-host PDKs.
Environment provenance: sha256, git/ngspice/PDK info, record ids, ngspice MARK parsing and PDK integrity (frozen-output-shape COMPATIBILITY CONTRACT).
RF arithmetic: the single declaration of the Boltzmann constant and the noiseless-source noise factor (issue #262; re-homing PRs must update this entry).
hbt-kaband-characterization block postprocessor: sweep model, manifest parsing, device-validity windows and QC tolerances.
lna-sparam-nf block postprocessor: reference-noise arithmetic and the legacy (T0 = 290 K) source correction.

upstream._comment: These sim/harness/ modules are scaffolded from sim-harness-core (distilled from 2AMLogic/gf180-sar-adc by everyblock/scaffold.sh). Their master is upstream, not here: a consumer pins them against the upstream repo, never against this one. A module lands in this list only by the ownership test above (adding commit 9dad16b) — a later addition to the README generic-core table stays this repo's master.
